resources.string: Classic Bluetooth sensors and local measurements

Pair your adapter in Android settings first and close other OBD apps. Standard sensors only; availability depends on the vehicle. After you start, recording continues during guidance with a notification and Stop action. It stops on disconnect, an error, its recording limit or when the app task is dismissed. Measurements stay on this device until export. Fuel level is a percentage, not litres; air flow is not converted into fuel consumption. Vehicle calibration has not yet been validated.
Bluetooth permission is required to connect.

resources.string: After adding a station, wait for routing to finish, then return here.
Prepare a driving route without intermediate stops, add a station here, wait for recalculation and return. This comparison expires after 30 minutes or any further route change.

Compare the original route with the recalculated road route. A compatible active vehicle, current energy level and price less than one day old are required. Enter the quantity to buy and stop duration. Combined fees include tolls, parking and station charges: leave blank if unknown; enter zero only if verified. No purchase is recorded as an actual refill.

Check the active vehicle, matching fuel, fresh station price, unchanged route and non-negative numbers. Quantity must exceed zero. Only one fuel tank is supported in this comparison.

resources.string: Bison Futé events and local cache

Source: Bison Futé / French road authorities, Open Licence 2.0. Partial coverage of the national road network excluding concession motorways. Notices within 50 km of the route start, otherwise the map centre, using reported coordinates only. This is not a complete route check. Direction and affected carriageway are not matched to your route. No notice does not mean free-flowing traffic. No delay or rerouting is inferred. The national aggregate updates hourly; no position is sent.
